# theVinesh.com

> Vinesh Raju is a senior software engineer in Dublin. He builds Android apps, Kotlin Multiplatform software, and writes about AI agents, vibe coding, and running software on absurdly small machines. Relevant to: software engineering, mobile development, Kotlin, Android, AI agents, local LLMs.

## Key pages

- [Resume](https://www.thevinesh.com/pages/resume/): Vinesh Raju's professional resume: 9+ years, senior software engineer, Android/Kotlin/mobile platforms, SDKs at 100M+ scale, DAA app, Zoho SSO.
- [Builds](https://www.thevinesh.com/builds/): Shipped projects including Wack-A-Moji (Kotlin Multiplatform game on Android, iOS and web) and Pulse.
- [My always-on agent setup](https://www.thevinesh.com/posts/my-always-on-agent-setup/): How Vinesh runs an always-on AI agent (ntran) on a free-tier 1GB VM for zero cost.
- [Dragon riding: the art of vibe coding](https://www.thevinesh.com/posts/dragon_riding_vibe_coding/): A playful take on vibe coding with AI agents.
- [Running local models for coding](https://www.thevinesh.com/posts/running_local_models_for_coding_and_co_work/): Local LLMs on cheap hardware.
- [Hardening a cheap VM](https://www.thevinesh.com/posts/hardening_a_cheap_vm/): Securing a budget cloud box.

## Optional

Vinesh is open to full-time and contract senior software engineering roles worldwide (work authorization in Ireland, no visa sponsorship needed). Contact details are on the resume page.
